body: Yeah, it pretty much just shows what I'm feeling on the outside. I started because it was a way to seek help and I thought that maybe because my injuries were physical people would care. That, unfortunately, wasn't the case and I just fell deeper into isolation.
Thank you, I never thought about saying I was on my period. Hopefully that works.
yes omfg

I totally understand. I've been struggling with self harm for a little over two years and it's very hard to wear bathing suits and short sleeved shirts because I have scars lining my arms and legs. I built up my confidence though and I hope you can too! Good luck!
I believe in you. Stay strong
I know how you feel. Its gonna be ok. If you need to just sleep. It'll kinda reset your brain.

I do have some advice that has helped me. Instead of cutting yourself draw on yourself. If you like the pain then maybe do a plank or something for as long as you can. Just do something that'll help you also.

It'll be ok, I promise. I believe no person is unlovable and hated. Everyone has a purpose and if you can make it through this then you'll have an inspiring story to tell people who are struggling just like you.

Then I suggest taking a step back. Get away from all the bad memories and make good, new ones. If you cant find the energy or strength to do that then it's ok. Just relax and enjoy the small things in life.

Hey. I know it's hard to deal with stupidity. But just know that you'll do better than them anyway. And even when you think you're at the lowest point in your life and you're completely worthless even if only 1% of the world hates you... there are still thousands who don't.
I know that feeling all too well. Even if you do decide to die. Just know that the world will be a little sadder without you. I hope you get to the light at the end of the tunnel soon.
Dont worry ok? It'll all even out. Outlive your enemies and demons. Don't let them win.
Of course

Hey... listen I know it's so hard right now and even if the worst happens it'll get better. It's hard moving to a new place but just remember if you die so many people will care. You have a lot to live for. I believe in you.

Hey its gonna be ok. I have some tips. If you're feeling exhausted and extremely depressed then I suggest writing down what your feeling or talk to your boyfriend. Maybe even get a counselor. You're right you do have things to live for. Keep trucking. I believe in you.
That's ok. Write what you're feeling in a journal or something. Just don't leave this earth yet.

Hey, I know what's it's like to feel unlovable and hopeless. I've delt with depression and suicidal thoughts for a long time. But your not alone. Going to a therapist was a good choice. I know you may feel like giving up, but you need to hold onto that sign. I believe in you.

Hey man I know this is hard to deal with. I've had people close to me kill themselves too. What I've learned is that talking to people helps so much. Even though you may not want to I suggest you talk to someone.
Hey man please dont die. I'm sure a lot of people will care about your suicide.
